displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E17
meaning: No return signal from the blower: the integrated furnace control does not see the motor answer.
causes: 4-pin motor communication connector not installed or not fully seated on the IFC
9-pin connector at the blower vestibule panel not seated
4-pin connector at the blower not seated
Motor wiring without continuity, or a motor the chart says to replace
diySteps: Leave the blower door on. Seating these connectors is inside the cabinet

Technician: disconnect power, seat the 4-pin communication connector on the IFC, the 9-pin connector at the blower vestibule panel, and the 4-pin connector at the blower. Then verify continuity of the motor wiring and replace the motor if required
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E17 is no return signal from the blower. If removing the 4-pin connector with power on changes the code to E17, that test belongs to E18.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
